context: A mom comforts her young son about a missing cat
purpose: Teach: 木曜日/ネコ/彼等/他方/昨今/去る/こりゃ/あつ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、うちのネコがいない…どうしよう、こりゃ大変だ。
lines.en: Mom, our cat is gone... what do I do, this is awful.
lines.style: Tearful young boy panicking about missing pet

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。木曜日の夕方から見てないのよね？
lines.en: Calm down. You haven't seen her since Thursday evening, right?
lines.style: Gentle motherly tone, reassuring and calm

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…ネコって急に家を去ることがあるって友達が言ってた。彼等が言うには、二度と帰ってこないって。
lines.en: Yeah... my friend said cats sometimes suddenly leave home. They say they never come back.
lines.style: Worried child repeating something heard from peers

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そういう子もいるけど、他方ではお腹がすいたら必ず帰ってくる子も多いのよ。
lines.en: Some cats are like that, but on the other hand, many come back when they get hungry.
lines.style: Soft maternal reassurance with patient explanation

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと？外、あついから心配だよ…
lines.en: Really? It's hot outside, so I'm worried...
lines.style: Small voice trembling with childlike concern

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨今のネコは賢いから大丈夫。一緒に探しに行こう、見つかるといいね。
lines.en: Cats these days are clever, so it'll be fine. Let's go look together — I hope we find her.
lines.style: Warm encouraging mother offering comfort and action

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ママと一緒なら頑張れる！
lines.en: Yeah, if I'm with you, Mom, I can do it!
lines.style: Brightening child finding courage through mother

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうね、きっといいアイディアが浮かぶわ。さあ、行きましょう。
lines.en: That's right, a good idea will surely come to us. Come on, let's go.
lines.style: Confident gentle mother leading her son forward
